mapper.sql: WHERE p.use_yn = 'Y' AND b.use_yn = 'Y' AND (p.approval_cd <> 'APPROVAL02' OR p.approval_id IS NOT NULL) AND p.approval_cd = #{approvalCd} AND p.board_id = #{boardId}::integer AND p.title ILIKE '%' || #{keywordLike} || '%' ESCAPE '\'

p.post_id::TEXT AS row_id, p.board_id::TEXT AS board_id, b.name AS board_name, p.title, p.reg_id, (SELECT COALESCE(u.nickname, '회원') FROM member u WHERE u.member_id = p.reg_id) AS reg_name, CASE WHEN p.p_post_id > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS reply_yn, p.approval_cd, c.name AS approval_name, p.approval_memo, p.approval_id, TO_CHAR(p.approval_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS approval_dt, CASE WHEN p.approval_cd = 'APPROVAL01' AND p.approval_dt IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS resubmit_yn, TO_CHAR(p.reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS reg_dt, TO_CHAR(p.upd_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS upd_dt
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM post p JOIN board b ON b.board_id = p.board_id LEFT JOIN code c ON c.code_id = p.approval_cd AND c.p_code_id = 'APPROVAL00'
ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.approval_cd = 'APPROVAL01' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CASE WHEN p.approval_cd = 'APPROVAL01' THEN p.upd_dt END ASC, p.approval_dt DESC NULLS LAST, p.post_id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post p JOIN board b ON b.board_id = p.board_id

SELECT , p.content FROM post p JOIN board b ON b.board_id = p.board_id LEFT JOIN code c ON c.code_id = p.approval_cd AND c.p_code_id = 'APPROVAL00' WHERE p.post_id = #{rowId}::integer AND p.use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET approval_cd = #{approvalCd}, approval_memo = #{approvalMemo}, approval_id = #{approvalId}, approval_dt = NOW() WHERE post_id = #{rowId}::integer AND use_yn = 'Y' AND approval_cd = 'APPROVAL01'
